referenceBoundary: Only approved own apricot-chat mother and matching approved empty environment plate. Umiri v2 only; no held v1 or other activity mother. Repaint real unified light, preserve original close camera/pose/support/scale.
prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. ONE complete 1536x1024 literary-room CHAT mother with the approved character's exact seated chat pose under unified new room/weather lighting.
IMAGE 1 is the ROOT-APPROVED MATCHING EMPTY WEATHER ROOM: it is authoritative for the ENTIRE environment and light. IMAGE 2 is the ROOT-APPROVED APRICOT CHAT MOTHER: authoritative for THIS character's identity, clothing, pose, body proportions, image location and actual contact/support. Use ONLY these two images. Preserve the complete original camera, room perspective/window divisions, desk/chair/shelves/books/plants/pictures, ceramic lamp/round table/cup/flowers, bench/plaid pillows/knitted throw, rug/floor and foreground depth from image 1. Place the same character from image 2 in her original position/size on that bench and REPAINT her and contact receiver material in image 1's light.
POSE IS LOCKED to image 2: preserve head tilt/eye direction, shoulder/torso lean, pelvis position, arms/elbows/wrists and hand placement; one palm rests on the real cushion beside hip at the viewer-right, other hand rests on lap/skirt. Both hands EMPTY. Don't invent a book, cup, gesture, outfit change, face swap or new activity. No crop, enlargement, leaning toward lens, zoom, moved furniture or separate body translation. Keep complete hair/head, both hands, hem, legs and both complete shoes.
Redraw coherent physical light and material response across face/hair/skin/clothing/shoes, cushion, contact shadows, wood and floor. This is not an overlay, global color wash, CSS tint or left/right day-night split. REMOVE all mismatching hard sunny leaf/bar highlights and noon outlines inherited from apricot image 2. Cast/contact softness, skin exposure, leather/fabric highlights and floor reflections must agree with image 1's actual light. Original lamp is the only local warm practical here; do not add another lamp.
Fine original youthful Japanese anime identity integrated into richly painted room, not mature/chibi. Separate hair strands, cheek strands, upper eyelids/lashes, iris and pupils. All eyes remain readable, never dark fringe merged into iris. No UI, text, badges, speech bubbles, arrows, motion trails, halo, signature, watermark or split view. One opaque whole room mother, not a cutout/layer.

CHARACTER AND EXACT CORRECT V2 POSE: Yahata Umiri (八幡海铃), image 2's charcoal shoulder-length layered hair/side fringe, readable gray-teal eyes, small earrings/choker; same black leather jacket, burgundy top, gray belted pleated short skirt and full black lace-up platform boots. Keep dark hair/leather/cloth distinct under new lighting. Preserve original V2 seated chat silhouette, slight torso/head inclination, one hand on lap and one supporting palm on cushion. Head top near y130, hip about y550..585 and complete soles near y910, same source size. Two knees SIDE BY SIDE with natural separation, two continuous naturally parallel calves, TWO complete independent boots EACH bearing weight on original floor. No crossed thigh/knee/ankle, detached/overlapping leg relation or wrong held v1 pose.
LITERARY CHARACTER BEAT: capable and concise yet gently warm, direct gray-teal eyes, restrained dry-humored softness at mouth rather than a generic reassurance grin. Keep the existing chat look and sober youthful identity. Rain never automatically means sadness; no new sulking or outfit change.

TARGET LIGHT — VIOLET / TWILIGHT: Follow image 1's CONTINUOUS rose/lilac dusk across the whole sky/window, same town/lake with early lights and reflections. Dusk fills the entire room softly; existing ceramic lamp provides local warm light from viewer-left that falls naturally over nearby skin/hair/fabric and receiver surfaces, with quieter cool dusk fill in far planes. No unchanged noon patches, hard sunny rim on head/skin, added sun disc, half-day/half-night window or midnight replacement. Clothing retains actual colors/materials under sunset and lamp; no global purple paint.
reviewBoundary: This one weather/time chat mother only. Prior apricot mother and empty-plate approvals do not transfer approval to this new mother, layers or runtime.

producerObservations: Personally viewed complete saved Umiri twilight mother before final rain. Continuous rose/lilac sky, lake/town lights and lamp-bearing dusk room match approved plate, with coherent darker skin/leather/boots/floor material response.
Correct v2 chat head/torso and hand placements, seated hip, two side-by-side knees/continuous calves and two full grounded boots remain visually coherent. No new prop, crossed legs or changed outfit.
Layered charcoal hair, gray-teal irises/eyelids and subtle dry-humored mouth remain legible; young identity and restrained warmth stay present.
producerConcerns: Warm rim on some hair/skin is interpreted as dusk/practical-light rendering, not proven physically measured illumination. Primary should judge unified light plausibility; no pixel-identical shape or runtime claim.
